synthesizedFacts.fact: Ceramides are lipids that make up 30-50% of the skin's outer layer and are crucial for maintaining the skin barrier and moisture retention.
Ceramides can be natural or synthetic, with synthetic versions often used in skincare due to their stability and purity.
Ceramide levels in the skin decrease with age and environmental damage, leading to dryness and increased sensitivity.
Ceramides are beneficial for conditions like eczema and psoriasis due to their role in skin barrier repair.
